messages:
Dana (AE): Heads-up: Beacon Health just expanded the PoC ask — they want real-time QA of clinical notes + embeddings-based rerank for search. Also BYO-KMS. They want 100 concurrent streams and ~1.5s p95. Can we do that in the current 3-week PoC and budget? :grimacing:
Priya (SE): 100 concurrent low-latency streams + embeddings + BYO-KMS is a heavy combo. Need to clarify streaming protocol and whether rerank can be async. 1.5s p95 is aggressive at that concurrency for medium models.
Casey (CSM): Customer says rerank must be sub-2s perceived latency. They'd accept rerank as a background step if the UI shows near-real-time results and final ranking updates within 2s.
Leo (Infra): BYO-KMS means we must integrate with their KMS endpoint or do key-wrapping. For 100 streams we should provision a Dedicated pool. Estimate: 2-4 GPUs reserved for stable p95, network setup ~2 days, KMS integration 3 days. Storage: logs + embeddings retention 30d => extra storage/IO costs.
Omar (Security): Clinical data => HIPAA considerations. If BYO-KMS, we need explicit attestation, key usage policy, and an audit trail. Also require encryption-in-transit confirmation and a signed DPA. Will update the security questionnaire.
Dana (AE): Can you quantify cost delta roughly? Need a short paragraph for legal & procurement.
Leo (Infra): Rough quick delta: Dedicated reservation adds ~$Y/day, extra GPUs add $Z/day, KMS onboarding effort is SRE time ~X engineer-days. I'll provide a short estimate sheet. Also, which model family? Embedding model size matters for throughput.
Priya (SE): We should propose an alternative: run streaming front-end + lightweight generator (13B quantized) for immediate responses and do embeddings/rerank on a separate batch pipeline that updates results within 2s. That reduces SLO pressure on the generator.
Casey (CSM): I'll ask Beacon if they can accept a hybrid flow. Also asking which KMS vendor (Thales, AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault, etc.) and region.
Dana (AE): If they insist on single-path strict 1.5s p95 for end-to-end rerank for 100 concurrent, we need to push for on-prem or private and a longer timeline + higher budget. State that clearly.
Omar (Security): Note: hosted BYO-KMS for PHI is sensitive. Recommend Private/VPC for HIPAA POCs. Hosted with key-wrapping could be possible but requires legal/arch signoff and is higher risk.
Priya (SE): Acceptance criteria suggestion: (1) Provide sample transcripts and 50 canonical queries for rerank; (2) Synthetic load test with 100 concurrent sessions for 15 minutes; (3) E2E latency p95 <1.8s for 90% of runs (if they insist on 1.5s we'll note tradeoffs); (4) embeddings quality check via top-5 MRR >= 0.7 on their eval set.;
Priya (SE): Starter prompt set for streaming QA (we'll refine):
```
- user: "Summarize the latest clinical note into 3 bullets with action items"
- user: "Extract medication changes and dosages from this paragraph"
- user: "Short answer: Is this a follow-up required? Yes/No and reason"
```
Dana (AE): Good. Assignments: Leo -> infra cost + timeline doc (EOD tomorrow). Omar -> security questionnaire + HIPAA recommendations (EOD). Priya -> proposed architecture diagram + model suggestions for hybrid flow (+2 days). Casey -> confirm KMS vendor & budget flex with Beacon (today). I'll draft an addendum once we have numbers.
Casey (CSM): Beacon replied: they're on AWS KMS, in us-east-1, and are open to the hybrid flow but prefer end-to-end for the demo. Budget is TBD — asking us for cost estimate first.
Leo (Infra): Noted AWS KMS us-east-1. That helps. Quick infra note: cross-AZ latency and egress are OK within region, but sustained 100 streams with embeddings will need autoscaling tuned; recommend Dedicated with burst to private lane.
Dana (AE): If they agree to Dedicated and pick the hybrid flow, can we keep 3-week PoC?
Priya (SE): Likely yes with Dedicated. If they require full end-to-end strict 1.5s for 100 concurrent on hosted, push to 6+ weeks and higher costs.
deploy-bot: Deploy planned: reserved-dedicated-pool job created (pending PO). :gear:
Omar (Security): Also request that Beacon sign MSA appendix for PHI handling and KMS connectivity before key exchanges.
Casey (CSM): I'll fast-track communications and get back with their preference within today.
Dana (AE): Thanks all. I'll craft a concise email with two options (Hybrid + Dedicated recommended vs Hosted full E2E with longer timeline) and request selection by EOD tomorrow.
